step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified all entities on the whiteboard: PBC (ThirdParty), API Gateway (PBC), Lambda (PBC), DynamoDB, SNS FIFO, SQS FIFO (Tenant), Tenant App (ThirdParty), API Gateway (Tenant), Lambda (Tenant), and SQS FIFO (PBC).
2. Verified node classifications against the Valid Vocabulary List. PBC and Tenant App are mapped to ThirdParty as external application integrations. AWS services use exact standard names (ApiGateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS).
3. Identified two main communication workflows described in audio and visually on the board:
   - Flow 0: Ingestion from PBC (e.g. PIM system) through API Gateway (PBC), Lambda (PBC) querying DynamoDB for rules, publishing to SNS FIFO, and delivering to SQS FIFO (Tenant).
   - Flow 1: Return/reciprocal flow from Tenant App through API Gateway (Tenant), Lambda (Tenant), publishing to SNS FIFO, delivering to SQS FIFO (PBC), and consumed by PBC.
4. Formatted edge sequences, flow IDs, and edge types accurately.

graph.name: Spryker Application Composition Platform Architecture
graph.notes: Spryker ACP connects Packaged Business Capabilities (PBCs) and Tenant Applications securely using FIFO messaging with dynamic routing rules stored in DynamoDB.

nodes.name: PBC
nodes.notes: Packaged Business Capability / SaaS application on the left side (e.g., PIM system)

nodes.name: API Gateway (PBC)
nodes.notes: Entry point for incoming PBC messages

nodes.name: Lambda (PBC)
nodes.notes: Glues API Gateway and SNS FIFO, enforcing authorization and routing rules

nodes.name: DynamoDB
nodes.notes: Tenant register service storing dynamic routing rules

nodes.name: SQS FIFO (Tenant)
nodes.notes: Tenant queue for asynchronous message processing

nodes.name: Tenant App
nodes.notes: Custom tenant application on the right side

nodes.name: API Gateway (Tenant)
nodes.notes: Entry point for incoming tenant application messages

nodes.name: Lambda (Tenant)
nodes.notes: Processes tenant messages before forwarding to SNS FIFO

nodes.name: SQS FIFO (PBC)
nodes.notes: Queue holding messages destined for PBC applications

edges.notes: PBC sends price update or data message to API Gateway
Lambda retrieves dynamic rules from DynamoDB tenant register
Lambda publishes message with applied rules to SNS FIFO
SNS FIFO routes message to Tenant SQS FIFO queue based on dynamic rules
Tenant application sends message to API Gateway
Lambda publishes tenant message to SNS FIFO topic
SNS FIFO routes message to PBC SQS FIFO queue
PBC consumes message from SQS FIFO queue
